title: Survey dwelling record
description: One dwelling per record, written one per line as JSON Lines. This validates the envelope only -- field names are deliberately open, because the field set is gated on IT-38. What it does enforce is that every leaf is a field object, never a bare value. See docs/decisions/D007-output-record-schema.md.

schema_version.description: Envelope version. The field set moves independently of this.

region.description: Region batch this dwelling belongs to (FR-02). Repeated on every line so a record survives concatenation.

batch.description: Source batch identifier, e.g. the scan PDF this came from.

field.description: Every extracted leaf. Bare values are not permitted anywhere in this schema.

value.description: As read, kept as text so leading zeros on codes like '04' survive. Null only when status is not 'ok'.

code.description: The code book code, where one applies.

label.description: Code book meaning of `code` (FR-07). Sentinels carry their meaning here -- '999' is labelled, not treated as missing (FR-08).

status.description: FR-09. ok: The field was read successfully and contains a usable value. no_data: The source field is present but contains no value to extract. illegible: The source field contains markings that cannot be read reliably. damaged: The source field cannot be read because its source area is damaged or obscured. omitted: The expected field was not returned by the extractor.

confidence.description: FR-10. Nullable: raw-OCR engines have no per-field score, and null says so rather than claiming certainty (NFR-01).

negated.description: FR-06 -- crossed out, read as implicit negation of the option.

origin.description: NFR-05. A human correction stays distinguishable from the machine value.

original_value.description: The machine value this replaced. Required when origin is 'corrected'.

source.description: NFR-06 / D006 -- which card this value came from, on traceability-relevant values.

field_map.description: An open set of named fields. Names are not fixed here; the constraint is that each value is a field object.

card_role.description: 'secondary' covers the unidentified card type in FR-21, pending the prevalence check.

image.description: Path or identifier of the source scan.

page.description: Page number within the source batch PDF.

confidence.description: FR-20 -- card-level score, alongside the per-field ones.

families_in_dwelling.description: From the survey front. How many household cards to expect below.

house.description: Fields describing the building rather than any one household -- structure, age, facilities.

record_id.description: municipality-dwelling-household, zero padded. Dwelling number alone is not unique across municipalities.

head.description: Head attributes from the coding card -- age, sex, occupation, earnings.

counts.description: Demographic aggregates from the coding card. These are counts of people, not people.

coding.description: Remaining coding-card fields for this household -- tenure, rent, income.

persons.description: From the survey front's column grid. The coding card contributes none of these.

relationship.description: To the head -- the only person field the grid always carries.
